FULL TEXT:
STENOGRAPHER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.95/R&A Dated:08th December, 2025
This is for information to all concerned that Computer Based Written Test comprising
English Shorthand-Computer Typing Test, Multiple Choice Question based Objective Test and
English Computer Typing Test for the Stenographer Recruitment Examination, 2025 (under
Advertisement No. PHC/02/2025) is scheduled to be held tentatively on 22.12.2025 (Monday) in
three shifts at various examination centres situated in Patna.
Admit Cards of eligible candidates shall be available on the official website of the High
Court i.e. https://patnahighcourt.gov.in/notices/recruitments one week before the scheduled
date of the test. An intimation in this regard will be sent to the candidates through SMS and e-
mail on their registered mobile number and e-mail ID. Admit Card would not be sent to the
candidates separately through any other mode.
Examination centres once allotted to the candidates shall be final and no communication
with regard to change of examination centre shall be entertained.
The candidates are directed to strictly follow the instructions mentioned in the Admit
Card.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website regularly for further
details/updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
